ActorId.name: X-Actor-Id
ActorId.description: Role-header auth stub: actor id (e.g. cust-001).

ActorRole.name: X-Actor-Role
ActorRole.description: CUSTOMER | UNDERWRITER | ADMIN. SYSTEM or unknown → 401.

XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
XCorrelationId.description: Echoed on the response; a UUID4 is generated when absent.

Money.description: Decimal money as a JSON string with two decimals (NFR-01). Never a JSON number.

DecimalString.description: Decimal rate/multiplier/share as a JSON string.

ActorRole.description: Accepted X-Actor-Role values. The internal SYSTEM role (DEC-010) is rejected with 401 if sent.

code.description: One of ErrorCode (a 500 response carries an implementation-defined code until conventions adds one, OI-3).

QuoteInputs.description: Per-product canonical fields (docs/conventions.md). TERM_LIFE: age, term_years, smoker. MOTOR: owner_age, vehicle_age_years, engine_cc, zone, ncb_percent. HOUSEHOLD: proposer_age, construction_type, in_flood_zone, has_security_system.

EndorsementRequest.description: CHANGE_ADDRESS: address. ADD_NOMINEE: nominee_name, relationship, share_percent. CHANGE_SUM_INSURED: new_sum_insured.
